groups.name: Second brackets
groups.scope: Exact signs for the ordered model defining functions.

groups.name: Tangent characteristic orbit
groups.scope: Every Hamilton equation and the characteristic identity at arbitrary positive radius.

groups.name: Ambient chord and endpoint exchange
groups.scope: Exact return time, both endpoint position shifts and the full characteristic polynomial.

groups.name: Two-fold form and mandatory cubic correction
groups.scope: Involution, exact pulled-back form, and nonzero error when the cubic position correction is omitted.

groups.name: Glancing linear homotopy
groups.scope: Rank-two nilpotence, full inverse identity and determinant, for symbolic perturbation and time.

groups.name: Nonconstant homogeneous relative correction
groups.scope: Euler primitive, determinant, exact Moser equation and conserved corrected normal momentum for delta=d(p_F/lambda) wedge dr.

groups.name: Variable defining factors
groups.scope: Four nonconstant homogeneous units test both second-bracket identities, including cancellation of their derivative terms.
